description.narrative:
Climate change, extreme inequality, and geopolitical instability are increasingly interconnected, with recent war in the Middle East and the resulting global energy crisis highlighting how dependence on fossil fuels drives economic vulnerability while generating windfall profits for fossil fuel companies. This has strengthened calls for progressive “polluter pays” taxes, such as the Rich Polluter Profit Tax and premium flyer levies, which can raise vital revenue for climate action, disaster response, public services, and reparative finance as development aid comes under pressure. Beyond revenue generation, these taxes can also help accelerate the shift away from carbon-intensive investment and consumption, supporting a more sustainable and equitable economy.
Public and political support for taxing major polluters continues to grow, reflected in strong public backing and increasing momentum in international initiatives such as the Global Solidarity Levies Task Force and UN Tax Convention negotiations. However, implementation remains slow due to limited political will, industry lobbying, concerns about economic competitiveness and household costs, and resistance from fossil fuel and aviation interests seeking to avoid new taxes.
The objective of the project is to build global and national support- particularly in the Netherlands, Germany, and Mexico - among civil society and governments for taxing rich polluters, such as a premium flyer levies and a rich polluter profit tax on fossil fuel companies.

participating-org.narrative: Oxfam Novib was founded in 1956 as the Netherlands Organisation for International Assistance (Novib), and joined forces with Oxfam in 1994. Oxfam Novib is member of the Oxfam International confederation. Working together in the confederation, the Oxfam affiliates can speak with one clear and compelling voice on issues of global concern: climate change, health and education for all, agriculture, trade, and conflicts and emergencies. Oxfam Novib's main office is based in The Netherlands, it supports the work of a network of local offices, the implementation of global projects, fundraising, campaigning and advocacy. Oxfam Novib’s the Hague office contributes towards this project’s implementation.
